stories.title: Implement EvaluateCare Facade Core Orchestration Logic
stories.description: Implement orchestration methods in evaluate_care_facade to coordinate clinical trials search and provider detail lookup by invoking domain services, handling parameter passing, and aggregating responses.

stories.title: Integrate EvaluateCare Facade with Tool Router
stories.description: Expose evaluate_care_facade methods through tool_router allowlist, ensuring proper tool registration, input validation flow, and compatibility with Anthropic tool_use handling.

stories.title: Implement Error Handling and Response Normalization
stories.description: Add standardized error handling, fallback behavior, and response normalization within the facade to ensure consistent outputs regardless of upstream API failures or partial data.

stories.title: Create Unit and Integration Tests for EvaluateCare Facade
stories.description: Develop unit tests for facade methods and integration tests covering end-to-end flows from tool_router through facade to domain services, including success and failure scenarios.
